tasks.prompt: Use PowerShell to simulate a tiny mouse movement (move 1 pixel right then back) to prevent Windows 11 screen lock. Run: powershell -Command 'Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; $pos = [System.Windows.Forms.Cursor]::Position; [System.Windows.Forms.Cursor]::Position = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(($pos.X + 1), $pos.Y); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50; [System.Windows.Forms.Cursor]::Position = $pos'. This keeps the system active without interfering with user work.
